sentences.text:
Author: Vivek Singh Thakur
Bench: Vivek Singh Thakur
Fao(Mva) No.141 of 2025 06.06.2025 Present: Mr. Jagdish Thakur, Advocate, for the appellant.

FAO(MVA) No.141 of 2025 Admit.
Record be requisitioned.
Post admission notice, returnable on next date, on taking steps within one week, be issued to the respondents.
List for further orders on 25th August, 2025.

CMP No.12822 of 2025 Subject to deposit of entire awarded compensation amount payable by appellant alongwith up-to-date interest thereon, in the Registry of this Court on or before 04.08.2025, execution and operation of the impugned award dated 10.03.2025, passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Mandi, Division Mandi, HP in Claim Petition No.113 of 2024 (2019), shall remained stayed during the pendency of the appeal.

opennyai_summary.decision:
FAO(MVA) No.141 of 2025 Admit.
Record be requisitioned.
Post admission notice, returnable on next date, on taking steps within one week, be issued to the respondents.
List for further orders on 25th August, 2025.
CMP No.12822 of 2025 Subject to deposit of entire awarded compensation amount payable by appellant alongwith up-to-date interest thereon, in the Registry of this Court on or before 04.08.2025, execution and operation of the impugned award dated 10.03.2025, passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Mandi, Division Mandi, HP in Claim Petition No.113 of 2024 (2019), shall remained stayed during the pendency of the appeal.
Alteration/vacation/modification on motion.
It is made clear that no deposit of amount in aforesaid terms shall result into automatic vacation of interim protection.
The application stands disposed of.
